- Upstream: https://github.com/dw5/Metropolis
- Pinned revision: `85fa62524e9eb40047bbf64830022e59a02cbaed`
- Requested OpenType file: https://github.com/dw5/Metropolis/blob/85fa62524e9eb40047bbf64830022e59a02cbaed/Fonts/OpenType/Metropolis-Bold.otf
- Runtime TrueType file: https://github.com/dw5/Metropolis/blob/85fa62524e9eb40047bbf64830022e59a02cbaed/Fonts/TrueType/Metropolis-Bold.ttf

Both font files are unmodified upstream originals. The game uses the matching
TrueType file because its validated font loader requires `glyf`/`loca` outlines.
Metropolis Bold supplies the fixed pause-menu and Training Settings headings.
